node.label: Premature closure of fontanelles
node.definition: Normally, the posterior and lateral fontanelles are obliterated by about six months after birth, the anterior fontanelle closes by about the middle of the second year. This term refers to the situation in which the fontanelles close at an inappropriately early time point.

evidence.snippet: Ceroid lipofuscinosis, neuronal, 10: Premature closure of fontanelles [IEA]
